# Ash & Ember

> Training for crews cleaning up after wildfires: household hazardous waste removal, ash and debris hazards, PPE and HAZWOPER courses for disaster cleanup contractors.

Ash & Ember (https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, First Responder Awareness, PPE Levels A–D or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). For crews removing hazardous materials. Enroll: https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). For limited-exposure cleanup roles. Enroll: https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize hazardous materials in debris. Enroll: https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: PPE Levels A, B, C & D Explained](https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained): $12.99 per seat, 15 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Choosing PPE for ash and debris. Enroll: https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained?buy=585
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Decontamination Procedures](https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Keeping ash off you and out of your truck. Enroll: https://wildfire-cleanup.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures?buy=584
